about: Files of the MC folder that are not in git, hosted in the project's Zenodo data record, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23466766 (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23466766). `make fetch-data` (code/package_tools/fetch_data.py) downloads them from base_url, checks bytes and sha256, and unpacks them into this folder. The raw trees (1D trajectories 0.655 TB; 2D and 3D chains, packed histograms and analyses, 257.5 and 237.2 GiB) are not hosted; they are available from the author on request.

files.name: MC__1d_refit_inputs.tar.gz
files.content: per-stage block archives (blocks_*.npz, summary.json) and merged summaries of the selected snapshot of each of the 20 couplings, byte-identical to production; every file is pinned by the coupling's analysis_v3_<snapshot>.manifest
files.needed_by: make refit1d, make refit-cited (REPRODUCE.md R7), the robust-ladder study

files.name: MC__1d_fits_per_degree.tar.gz
files.content: the per-degree fit results of the selected fit run of each coupling (every rung of every degree ladder), except the 19 that git tracks; no record pins them, so the cluster scratch prefix is replaced by <SCRATCH>
files.needed_by: inspection only; no make target needs them
